failure_mode: A source stops. The system reasons with data that is not true.
cause: An acquisition failure is not visible unless the system reports it.
effect: The system gives a confident answer from old data.
detection: The system compares delivery with the declaration.

failure_mode: An agent puts life state into material that reaches a person outside the platform.
cause: An agent that reads life state can also act on the outside world.
effect: You cannot reverse publication. This breaks the only firm data boundary that the user states.
detection: Work and Coordination holds the answer of the user for each action that reaches a third party, and Self-Observation holds the record of the action (DEC-169).

failure_mode: The system gives a superseded value as the current value.
cause: The reader decides if a value is current at the time that it reads the value.
effect: The user stops the use of the system. The user states this condition.

failure_mode: An agent gets authority that it did not receive, through a query.
cause: A question and a task use one mechanism.
effect: Any agent can do an action with no limit.
detection: The system compares authority before the query and after it.

failure_mode: An agent reaches an external service by a path that does not pass through External Access.
cause: A server that exposes the operations of a service is attached to the model of an agent, which is how agent frameworks attach it by default, or a part that an agent calls opens a connection of its own.
effect: An act on the outside world occurs with no classification and no record.

failure_mode: A part of the platform other than Agent Runtime makes a call that generates from a model.
cause: A model that composes content is the easy way to convert, to classify or to summarise when a part is built.
effect: Reasoning occurs with no position, no bound on its cost and a model outside change control. A converted item holds content that its source did not supply.
detection: External Access refuses the call (REQ-EX-045), and the calling system fails where a person sees it.

failure_mode: The work of an agent becomes less good over time in a way that shows only over many answers, and each answer looks acceptable alone.
cause: A provider changes a model, or an agent changes an agent (DEC-039), and no test of the build runs again.
effect: The user refuses more of its requests or gets more units with no result, and does not see the trend.
detection: A person finds it if the person looks.

failure_mode: An agent gives wrong answers that look correct.
cause: A provider changes a model, or an agent changes an agent (DEC-039), and no test of the build runs again. The rates of REQ-PL-036 do not change, because the user affirms the answers.
effect: The user acts on answers that are wrong, and no system fails.
detection: A person finds it only when the person traces a wrong answer back.
